text: Planning's done. This is real Python against the real container -- wrenfield-knowledge-docs -- walking all three folders and pulling in every file.
Each file type gets parsed into plain text its own way: pdfplumber for PDFs, BeautifulSoup for the wiki's HTML export, python-docx for the Word SOPs.
Every document gets chunked with tiktoken at 500 tokens, 50-token overlap -- real token counts, not a word-count guess.
Every chunk is tagged with its filename, source folder, and position, and written out ready for the embedding step.
Several thousand chunks, across all three folders, spot-checked by hand. Next: turning this into something people can actually ask questions of.
